title: 5 new things in your app!
intro: Build 3 from Mom's review: the Sunday film review is a little sheet in the app, Mom gets her own week card, your dance-time nudge knows what kind of day it is (and can nudge once more in the evening), Dance Along learns from Hannah's videos, and the doors, dares and costumes live on Play. Tap 👀 Show me how for the steps, or ▶ Try it to jump straight in.

items.pitch: On Sundays the film review is four little steps: the last run, what went well, did the fix show, a note.
steps: On a Sunday, the film-review item in practice mode has a “🎬 Sunday sheet” button. Today has one too.
Watch the last run together, then tap “Watched it ›”.
Say what went well. Mom types one word. Then “✓ It showed” or “Not yet” for this week's fix.
A note if you want, then “✅ Done”. The plan item ticks itself.

items.pitch: One card with the week in a glance: the plan week, the Sunday sheet, the fix, privates, the next checkpoint, the mini audience.
steps: Grown-ups (the PIN) → the card “👩 This week, for Mom” sits under the buttons.
Pink lines are the ones that need a hand: a Sunday sheet not filled, a private to book, a checkpoint to tick.
Ms. Brittany's homework closes in Skills & awards (“✓ Checked off”) once it showed on two videos in a row.

items.pitch: Your dance-time nudge says what today is: a watch day, a memory run or home practice. A second one in the evening if the plan isn't done.
steps: Me → “⏰ My dance time”: the nudge comes on plan days, with the day's kind.
“🌙 A second nudge” comes later in the evening only if the plan still isn't done. The button turns it “Off”.
Plan done ⭐ means no nudge at all that day.

items.pitch: Hannah's videos are offered in Dance Along: ＋ Learn it, no picking from Photos. The whole solo fits now.
steps: Play → Dance Along: under your dances, “📹 Hannah's videos” lists the solo's and trio's videos.
Tap “＋ Learn it”: the app reads the moves off the video that's already in the family space.
Then “▶ Dance” beside it: the video plays next to your camera and scores you, all the way to the ending.

items.pitch: Solo work first, the weekend games after the plan, and the extras: the countdown doors, the dare and the costume designer.
steps: Play has three parts: “🌸 Solo work”, “🎉 Weekend games” and “✨ Extras”.
Doors, dare and costume designer live in Extras. On Today they open under More once the plan is done ⭐.
On a home day the weekend games and the extras wait for the plan, like before.
